snippet.title: Plague Lords trailer (2023)
snippet.description:
Plague Lords is a turn-based tactical sandbox RPG, with city building, exploration, survival and tower defense elements, set in a grim world of 14th century Europe during the Black Death pandemic. The game is aiming for Steam Early Access release at Spring 2022.

Wishlist Now on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1827240/Plague_Lords/
